title: Tumble and the Wild Weather Walk
moral: Being brave means feeling a little scared and trying anyway.
description: Pip has never touched real snow, so Nana Hoot leads Pip and Tumble up, up, UP Tall Top Mountain! On the way they meet sunshine, wild wind, splashy rain and soft white snow, but Tumble feels a little scared. Learn four kinds of weather in this funny animated story for kids aged 3 to 8.

narration.text: Hi friends! Guess what? Pip the little fox has never, ever touched real snow!

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: Nana Hoot, where does snow live? I want to see it super-duper badly!

narration.speaker: nana
narration.text: Snow lives way up on Tall Top Mountain, where the air is cold. Hoo-hoo! Shall we go?
Tumble looked up, up, UP at the mountain. His knees went wibble... wobble... wibble!

narration.speaker: tumble
narration.text: It's sooo high. I feel a little scared... but I'll come with you!

popups.sub: the sun is hot and bright

narration.text: First, they skipped through Buttercup Meadow. Look up! What kind of weather is this?
It's SUNNY! Yay! The big yellow sun makes everything warm and bright!

narration.speaker: nana
narration.text: On sunny days, we wear a hat and drink lots of water... and we... zzzzz...
Nana fell asleep in the warm sunshine! Her glasses slid down... down... BONK!

narration.speaker: nana
narration.text: Hoo! I'm awake! I'm AWAKE!

narration.text: Next... WHOOOOSH! On Windy Hill, the trees wiggled and the windmill went round and round!

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: I know what wind is! It's a giant invisible bunny blowing raspberries! Pbbbbt!
Hee-hee! No, Pip! It's WINDY! Wind is moving air. We can't see it, but we can feel it!
ZIP! The wind blew Tumble's cap onto Pip's head. ZIP! Then back again. ZIP! Then onto a very surprised sheep!

narration.speaker: tumble
narration.text: Oopsie-trunk! HONK! Nice hat, Mister Sheep!

popups.sub: rain is water from the clouds

narration.text: Uh-oh! A big grey cloud floated over. Pitter-patter, pitter-patter! It's RAIN! Rain is water falling from the clouds.
Pip jumped in a puddle. SPLOOSH! He slid... wheeee... and landed on his fluffy tail. BONK!

narration.speaker: tumble
narration.text: Don't worry, Pip! My big ears make a super umbrella!

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: Super-duper! You're an umbrella-phant!
Then they came to a wobbly log bridge over a splashy, rushing stream.

narration.speaker: tumble
narration.text: Oh no... it's so wobbly. My tummy feels all fluttery.
Then... GRRRUMBLE! Pip jumped. Boing! Was it thunder? No! It was Tumble's hungry tummy! Hee-hee!
Tumble giggled. He took a big breath, held Pip's paw, and stepped across. One brave step at a time!

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: You did it, Tumble! You were scared, but you were brave!

popups.sub: snow falls when it is cold

narration.text: Higher and higher they climbed. Brrrr! The air got colder... and colder... and COLDER!
Then something soft and white floated down and tickled Pip's nose. What is it?
It's SNOW! Snow falls when it's very, very cold. Each snowflake is tiny and sparkly!

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: Look! Snow-flappies! Snow-flippers! Um... SNOWFLAKES!

narration.speaker: nana
narration.text: Hoo-hoo-HOO! Third time lucky, Pip!

popups.sub: snow is white, soft and cold

narration.text: At the very top of Tall Top Mountain, everything was white and cold! They built a snow-elephant with a long, snowy trunk.

narration.speaker: tumble
narration.text: Ah... ah... AH-CHOOOOO!
WHOOSH! Tumble's giant sneeze blew snow everywhere! Now Pip was a snow-fox, and Nana was a snow-owl!

narration.speaker: nana
narration.text: Hoo-hoo! Who turned off the sun? Oh... my glasses are full of snow!
Everybody laughed and laughed, and made snow angels. Even Tumble!

narration.text: On the way home, a rainbow smiled across the sky. Let's remember! What weather makes the trees wiggle?
WIND! Whoooosh! You got it!
And what weather falls from the clouds and makes puddles?
RAIN! Sploosh! You're a super weather watcher!

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: Sun, wind, rain and snow! Four kinds of weather! Super-duper!

narration.text: That night, back home, Nana made warm cocoa for everyone. Mmmm, yummy!

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: Thank you for being so brave, Tumble. I saw snow because of you!

narration.speaker: tumble
narration.text: I was scared... but I tried anyway! HONK! Now I feel ten feet tall!

narration.speaker: nana
narration.text: That's what brave means, little ones. Hoo-hoo! I'm so proud of you both.
And that night, Tumble dreamed of snow-elephants... and sneezes!
